payload.reason: The authors experimented with their model on CNN/DM due to the need to evaluate the effectiveness of hierarchical position embeddings in summarization tasks, particularly in comparison to other datasets with more pronounced hierarchical structures.

claims.text: The authors aimed to assess the summarization performance of their HiStruct+ models on CNN/DailyMail to compare it with other datasets like PubMed and arXiv, which have more obvious hierarchical structures.
The performance improvements on CNN/DailyMail were found to be small, indicating that the hierarchical structure of CNN/DailyMail documents is less pronounced than in other datasets.
